g.text: When does a displayed 4.4 move upward?

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #61736e

g.text: All = every feasible star total moves up. Some = only part of the feasible range moves up. Neither means a probability.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #61736e

g.text: Assumes equally weighted whole-star ratings and nearest-tenth, half-up rounding; Google does not confirm the tie rule.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #61736e

g.text: Calculated scenarios, not observed outcomes. ReviewRemoval, 8 October 2026 / CC BY 4.0. Download data and methods in the article.
